coverage: 26 bound contextual entries (HELP-110-001..025 + HELP-110-026 keyboard reference).

items.title: Appearance settings
items.short_text: Choose Light, Dark or System. System follows the appearance preference reported by your operating system or browser.
items.instructions: Choose a mode. Preview it, then save to My account or This browser. A local browser override takes priority over your account choice.

items.title: Text size
items.short_text: Increase or decrease MoneyCraft text size without changing your financial data.
items.instructions: Use the size controls or select a percentage. Reset returns to 100%. Browser zoom remains available independently.

items.title: Preference scope
items.short_text: My account follows you when you sign in. This browser affects this browser profile only.
items.instructions: Select the scope before saving. Use account settings in this browser removes the selected local override. It does not reset your account.

items.title: Settings conflict
items.short_text: These settings changed in another session. Review the saved values before applying your changes.
items.instructions: Reload current settings, compare the changed fields and apply your intended values deliberately. Unrelated newer values are retained.

items.title: Temporary settings
items.short_text: These settings apply for this session only because local storage is unavailable.
items.instructions: You can continue using the controls. Sign in and save to your account if available, or use this temporary setting until the session ends.

items.title: Keyboard settings
items.short_text: Choose character actions, a qualified modifier profile, or ordinary keyboard controls only.
items.instructions: Letters typed in entry fields must remain text. Saved shortcuts may be unavailable on a different keyboard or OS; ordinary Tab and button controls remain available.

items.title: Company selection
items.short_text: Choose the company you are authorised to work with.
items.instructions: Select a company, then Open. Switching company does not post a draft; resolve any pending or uncertain operation before switching.

items.title: Ledger selection
items.short_text: Select a ledger in the current company.
items.instructions: Search the authorised list. Select fills this line only. Create ledger is available only with permission. Close returns without changing the selected value.

items.title: Accounting date
items.short_text: This is the business date of the entry, within an allowed accounting period.
items.instructions: Choose the intended date and period. Applying a date selection does not save, approve or post the journal.

items.title: Journal amounts
items.short_text: Enter debit and credit amounts at the company currency precision.
items.instructions: Use valid ledgers. Check that total debit equals total credit before saving or posting. Display scaling does not change stored amounts.

items.title: Save draft
items.short_text: Save keeps an editable draft; it does not approve or post it.
items.instructions: Correct any highlighted fields. Wait for confirmation before leaving. If the outcome is unknown, use Check status instead of starting another save.

items.title: Approval
items.short_text: Approval records the required review of the current saved version.
items.instructions: Review the entry and total. Availability depends on your permission and the company approval policy. Changes can require fresh approval.

items.title: Posting
items.short_text: Posting commits the admitted journal to the accounts.
items.instructions: Review the company, date, period, version and total. Confirm once. A network interruption does not prove that posting failed.

items.title: Uncertain outcome
items.short_text: The server outcome has not yet been confirmed. Do not create a duplicate operation.
items.instructions: Use Check status. Retry original only when offered; it retains the same request identity. An unavailable result is not proof that nothing committed.

items.title: Concurrent edit
items.short_text: This record changed after you opened it.
items.instructions: Read the current version and compare your intended changes. Do not submit an old or redacted record as a blind replacement.

items.title: Report filters
items.short_text: Choose the report dates explicitly.
items.instructions: Apply requests the report for those bounds. Clear restores the selected period in the form; it does not run an unlimited report.

items.title: Report output
items.short_text: Print or export the authorised complete PDF for the selected report bounds.
items.instructions: Confirm the report and dates. Output requires the appropriate export permission. Printer acceptance may not prove that paper was printed.

items.title: Government integration profile
items.short_text: A profile binds one provider, environment and permitted company registration to approved operations.
items.instructions: Only Super Admin can view or change this configuration. Sandbox and production have separate bindings and credentials.

items.title: Replace credentials
items.short_text: Enter replacement credentials. Existing stored secrets cannot be revealed.
items.instructions: Stage the new version, validate it using an approved safe check, then apply it deliberately. Never paste credentials into help, logs or support messages.

items.title: Validate connection
items.short_text: Validation checks the exact staged configuration; it does not file a return or generate an invoice.
items.instructions: Review the declared safe probe, including any OTP or charge. A successful check applies only to the tested provider, environment and revision.

items.title: Apply integration
items.short_text: Apply switches new work to the validated configuration after fresh authentication.
items.instructions: Confirm provider, company registration and environment. Already submitted work retains its original profile for reconciliation.

items.title: Filing status
items.short_text: Uploaded, accepted, verified and filed are different provider states.
items.instructions: Read the recorded provider acknowledgement and status. Do not assume that uploading a file completed filing, or resubmit after an unknown response.

items.title: Desktop sign-in
items.short_text: Sign in through the approved browser page for your MoneyCraft server.
items.instructions: The desktop application does not save your password. Passkeys and password-manager options depend on the qualified browser and account policy.

items.title: Certificate failure
items.short_text: The server identity could not be verified. No credentials should be sent to this connection.
items.instructions: Check the configured server address. Ask the authorised administrator to correct the certificate or provision the approved trust profile; do not bypass the warning.

items.title: Local biometric unlock
items.short_text: A local biometric check can unlock protected device storage.
items.instructions: It does not restore expired server access or replace a server request to sign in again. Use the approved browser sign-in when required.

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts and function bar reference
items.short_text: Plain keys invoke direct function actions; single underline denotes Alt+Key; double underline denotes Ctrl+Key.
items.instructions: Function keys: F1 Help, F2 Working Date (Alt+F2 Period), F3 Select Company (Ctrl+F3 Shut Company), F4 Contra, F5 Payment (Alt+F5 Debit Note), F6 Receipt (Alt+F6 Credit Note), F7 Journal (Alt+F7 Stock Journal, Ctrl+F7 Physical Stock), F8 Sales (Alt+F8 Delivery Note, Ctrl+F8 Sales Order), F9 Purchase (Alt+F9 Receipt Note, Ctrl+F9 Purchase Order), F10 Other Vouchers, F11 Company Features, F12 Configure. Navigation and editing: Alt+G Go To, Ctrl+G Switch To, Alt+K/Y/Z/O/E/P Top Bar menus, Ctrl+H Change Mode, Ctrl+L Optional, Ctrl+I Tax Analysis, Alt+C Inline Create / Column / Calculator, Ctrl+R Repeat Narration, PageUp/PageDown Previous/Next Voucher, Ctrl+A Accept, Alt+2 Duplicate, Alt+I Insert, Alt+X Cancel, Alt+R/Alt+U Hide/Restore Line, Space/Ctrl+Space Select Rows, Shift+Enter Explode Details, and Escape Dismiss Topmost Help or Step Back.
